understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in every level, ultimately winning the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement is controlled by directional actions, while gravity determines the falling direction and can require positioning carefully. The player has 2 attempts per level and 50 turns per attempt; landing on spikes ends the attempt and restarts the level. Clicks and undo can affect the board or reverse actions when available. The recent movement became ineffective because repeated horizontal inputs left the player oscillating between adjacent positions without progressing.
